notes: Redevelopment Agency minutes 2001-2011 (twelve volumes, through the Agency's dissolution). Curated onto existing pages: schematic design approvals, nonprofit housing loans and ground leases, the Elouise Westbrook naming at 227-255 Seventh Street, and SRO hotel rehabilitation loans (owners, private people, not named).

coverage.remaining: Not placed or skipped: the Plaza Hotel at 988-992 Howard and 1355-1375 Sutter (no page on that side of the street); Episcopal Community Services' 1350 Folsom / 275 10th / 72 Dore site and the Auburn Hotel at 481 Minna (no page); office and parking leases (701 Mission, 560 Mission, 1286 and 1534 Fillmore, 174 Ellis, 4800 Third).
